preconditions.description: Input integers n, d, k are within the specified bounds.
Diameter d and number of vertices n are at least 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if (d > n - 1 or (d == 1 and n > 1) or (d == n - 1 and k < 2)) else True
postconditions.description: Output 'NO' if it's impossible to construct a tree with diameter d and max degree k, otherwise proceed to construct the tree.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n if stdout != 'NO' else False
postconditions.description: If 'YES', output must start with 'YES' followed by exactly n-1 lines of edges.

postconditions.expression: all(' ' in line and len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout != 'NO' else False
postconditions.description: Each edge line must contain two distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(line for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1 if stdout != 'NO' else False
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 unique edges (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= degree <= k for degree in [sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if u in line) for u in range(1, n + 1)]) if stdout != 'NO' else False
postconditions.description: Every vertex in the tree must have degree at most k.

postconditions.expression: max(diameter_of_tree(edges) for edges in [stdout.splitlines()[1:]]) == d if stdout != 'NO' else False
postconditions.description: The constructed tree must have diameter exactly d.
